title: achillea millefolium subsp. ceretanica
intro: Achillea millefolium subsp. ceretanica, commonly known as Corsican yarrow, is a subspecies of the yarrow plant, which is a flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating wounds, skin issues, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Corsican yarrow include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as exerting a calming effect on the nervous system. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
